offers.name: Offer A: Small-business website
offers.subtitle: Primary revenue engine — narrow enough to quote, deliver, and repeat
offers.targetCustomer: Local small businesses with slow, outdated, non-mobile, or hard-to-contact websites
offers.problemSolved: Customers struggle to contact the business or request quotes on mobile, resulting in lost local inquiries.
deliverables: Defined number of pages (up to 5 core pages: Home, Services, About, Reviews/Gallery, Contact/Quote)
Mobile-responsive design tested across mobile and desktop
Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta descriptions, local headings)
Agreed revision allowance (2 structured revision rounds)
exclusions: No complex third-party integrations without separate scope evaluation
offers.paymentStructure: 50% deposit ($750) upfront before work begins; 50% ($750) at agreed completion milestone.
offers.scriptOpening: Hi, is this the owner? My name is [your name]. I build websites for small businesses, with a focus on making it easier for customers to contact you and request work. I noticed [specific, truthful observation about their website]. I have an idea for improving that, and I can show you an example. I'm not asking you to buy anything on this call. Would you be open to a 10-minute demonstration?

objectionHandlers.response: For a standard 5-page small-business site with mobile quote requests and basic SEO, it's a fixed $1,500—half upfront, half when we review the completed site together. No surprise hourly billing.

I completely understand. The reason I reached out is that on mobile, your quote button takes several steps and doesn't load cleanly. Most local homeowners search from a phone. In 10 minutes, I can show you a clean mockup that captures those leads directly.

offers.name: Offer B: Website + Lead automation package
offers.subtitle: Higher average contract value with built-in speed-to-lead workflow
offers.targetCustomer: Service businesses missing phone calls, after-hours leads, or requiring automated appointment routing
offers.problemSolved: Inquiries sit unread for hours or days; businesses lose jobs to competitors who respond in 5 minutes.
deliverables: Everything in Offer A (5-page mobile-responsive website)
Owner notification routing directly to smartphone
exclusions: No custom enterprise CRM software build
No ongoing ad spend included in setup fee
offers.paymentStructure: 50% deposit ($1,250) upfront before work begins; 50% ($1,250) upon live demo and delivery verification.
offers.scriptOpening: Hi, is this the owner? My name is [your name]. Beyond modern websites, I set up automated lead capture that instantly texts customers back when you're on a job site so you don't lose emergency calls to competitors. Would you be open to a 10-minute demonstration of how this works?

objectionHandlers.objection: Can we just start with the regular website first?
objectionHandlers.response: Absolutely. We can start with the $1,500 website build, ensure you love the foundation, and add the lead automation package later once new inquiries start rolling in.

sidecarConfig.savedPitch: We help B2B trade, service, and manufacturing firms fix their single highest-friction website or mobile bottleneck with zero downtime, guaranteeing a measurable 20%+ increase in qualified inbound quote requests before proposing any full redesign.
callRules: Rule 1: Never pitch on the opener. Ask for 27 seconds to explain why you called.
Rule 2: Point to exactly one observable friction point (e.g., broken mobile form, 9s load time).
Rule 3: The sole goal of the cold call is securing a 10-minute screenshare demo, never closing on the phone.
Rule 4: Never push through hard objections; offer an opt-out to protect credibility.
Rule 5: Team rule: If someone requests DNC or removal, honour it immediately across all seats.
Rule 6: Maximum 60 contact detail reveals per seat per hour enforced by Sidecar.
